Meera Patel: Posting RCA for last night's serving disruption. Full doc: https://intranet.redwood.com/incidents/1930012345-summary (PDF + editable). TL;DR: KV-cache evictions during a gradual model rollout caused large cold-paths, retries, and elevated 5xxs for ~18-22m. No data exfiltration. Short timeline and action items below.

incident-bot: Incident record created and attached: https://intranet.redwood.com/incidents/1930012345 (internal).

Sam Ortiz: Thanks — can you paste top action items + owners so SRE/Infra can pick up?

Meera Patel: Sure. Top items (owner — target):

```
1) Restore conservative KV cache thresholds + guardrail (Kevin Liu) — due 2026-04-10
2) Add rollout compatibility checks to CI job (Carla) — due 2026-04-13
3) Implement warmup path for model-variant swaps (Dana Park) — due 2026-04-17
4) Trace tagging for cold-starts + Console tile (Sam Ortiz) — due 2026-04-12
5) Chaos test for cache eviction resilience (Meera Patel) — due 2026-04-20
```

Kevin Liu: I'll take #1. Plan: revert to previous stable thresholds, add sliding-window limiter + per-deploy safety cap. Will post config diff in #eng-runtime.

Carla: Taking #2. Will add pre-rollout checks (cache warming, KV size bounds). Opening PR with checklist.

Dana Park: #3 confirmed. Prototype prefills critical prompt prefixes for warmup; will run latency/cost benchmarks.

Sam Ortiz: #4 — will add trace tags for cold-hops and a dashboard tile in Console. Scheduling work.

Meera Patel: Mitigations performed last night: enabled fallback routing, throttled new-model percentage, increased autoscale headroom. Kept errors from spreading but some customers saw latency — details in the doc.

Priya: Which customers were affected? Need to prep notifications.

Meera Patel: Two high-traffic tenants in eu-west-1 with long prompt sequences. No data exposed. Priya — can you prepare a short notification template? Owner: Priya — due 2026-04-09.

Sam Ortiz: Scheduling 30m checkpoint to review progress on top 3 items.

Meera Patel: Checkpoint: 2026-04-07 10:00 PT (30m). Invite to Meera, Kevin, Carla, Dana, Sam, Priya. Agenda: PRs, config diff, warmup benchmarks.

Keisha: Thanks — flag blockers here if timelines slip.

Kevin Liu: Posted initial config diff: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/inference/changes/eviction-thresholds

Carla: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/platform/merge-requests/1245

Dana Park: Warmup prototype results: +2-3ms median latency, ~65% reduction in cold-path 503s in sim. Full numbers in follow-up.

Meera Patel: Marking the incident doc as single source of truth. If you need to escalate ping @meera. Thanks all :thumbsup:
